verdict.rationale: Tilled is a developer-facing payments platform with public docs, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack only covers conventional human-oriented docs (quick start, webhooks, testing, onboarding) and never mentions llms.txt, markdown-for-LLM docs, or agent-targeted documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
